bespoke_sweep.note_on_numbers: These are NOT the plan's own §1.3/§4.3 numbers (measured on a DIFFERENT rig: engine.addLayer + box-density-bearing's app-default camera/light/ground/tone at fillAngle 20). This sweep uses the gallery capture rig's own camera/light convention (Params.DEFAULT_CAMERA, single directional sun, no ground) at fillAngle 45 to match FIXED_ZOOM framing. Both rigs independently show the SAME mechanism: monotone increase, ceiling saturation on the smaller facet, and the dark carrier facet held exactly flat.
box_observations: face:+Z (the dark, already-ruled carrier) stays at EXACTLY 11 rulings at every control value — the floor never darkens what Density has already ruled
face:+Y plateaus below its own zone ceiling (6 rulings at control 8, not 8) — the ceiling still wins
face:+X reaches the full 8 at control 8 (its own ceiling is higher than face:+Y's)
solid_observations: face:19 and face:21 saturate EARLY (plateau at 3/2 rulings from control 3 onward) — small facets with tight zone ceilings, exactly the ceiling-still-wins invariant on a 12-facet body
images_examined_at_native_resolution: box__control1.png / box__control3.png / box__control8.png — full frame, LOOKED at directly (not just cropped): at control 1 the top (+X) and right (+Y) facets read as nearly bare (1-2 sparse diagonal strokes each) against the densely-ruled left (+Z) facet; at control 8 the top and right facets are filled with parallel rulings approaching the density of the left facet — the box reads dramatically more evenly filled, exactly the plan's described trade ('at 8 the box reading flat').

crop_right_c1.png / crop_right_c8.png (395x300 native-resolution crop of the +Y/right facet region) — at c1: a single long diagonal stroke, mostly bare paper. At c8: the same facet region carries 5+ clean parallel rulings, correctly inset from the facet edges, with clean intersections at the ridge shared with +X. No overshoot past the silhouette, no gaps, no rendering artifacts at either extreme.

solid__control1.png / solid__control8.png — full frame. At c1 most visible facets carry exactly ONE short stroke each ('a single stripe per lit facet', matching the plan's own description verbatim). At c8 the same polyhedron is densely cross-hatched-looking (still single-direction hatch per facet, but many parallel rulings per facet) — a dramatically fuller read, no artifacts, no ink outside any facet boundary.
